findings.finding: The observation structure reads as the source equipment pedestal above the walk. The upper slab/socket has no stair or other reachable human route. Below the slab the X-braced enclosure does not show a clear occupiable observation space. The promised continuous walk-to-observation route is not established.
findings.repair: Use one actual occupiable observation floor flush with the guardwalk. Remove the inaccessible upper socket slab. Keep a modest waist-height outer rail, with a visibly broad open entry facing the walkway. Move structural braces beneath the occupiable floor or to non-entry exterior faces. If an overhead canopy is retained, give it clearly tall posts and no X-brace crossing the occupied bay. Apply the identical design to all3 views.

findings.finding: The roofed deck is a more plausible occupied space, but its junction with the walk is not unambiguously open: the perimeter railing/raised threshold and post overlap obscure a continuous usable entry. No clearly unobstructed landing-to-lookout passage is shown. Exact world dimensions and standing headroom cannot be certified from this static drawing.
findings.repair: Align the lookout floor with the walkway or expose an explicit shallow step and unobstructed landing. Remove the rail only on the walkway-facing entry bay; show its gap clearly from both interior and high access views. Raise the roof posts enough that the occupied space unmistakably has standing headroom relative to the guardrail, preserving the same roof/floor/support geometry in all3 views. Keep the ground-level supply alcove separate from pedestrian admission.

positive_evidence: Guardwalk adds a broad raised walk and clear camp-side stair/open landing compared with a plain fence.
Fortified stage adds substantial masonry/blue structure, a roofed lookout and a separate covered ground supply alcove.
Orange timber, blue metal/roof, rounded gray masonry and snow remain in the supplied source family.
Exterior/interior relationship, stair end opposite tower and separate ground supply alcove are coherent enough to retain during repair.
